findings.title: Shell command built from untrusted input
findings.body:
`run_report` passes `name` into a shell string with `shell=True`, so a report name like `x; rm -rf ~` runs a second command.
findings_block_end
Use an argument list and drop `shell=True`.

findings.title: Docstring says the function returns a path
findings.body: The docstring promises a path but the function returns the exit status.
findings.evidence: """Render the report and return its path."""

overall_explanation: The new report helper is injectable through its name argument.
